items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of Brauchtumsfeuer permit
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Behörde: Amt Musterschlei, Am Markt 6, 24376 Musterkappeln.
items.computation: Letter dated and posted 18.11.2026 (Wed), no separate 'Aufgabe zur Post' date stated, so posting day = document date. Letter itself confirms general-authority rule (§ 110 Abs. 2 LVwG): deemed delivery = 4th day after posting, counting calendar days, day of posting not counted as day 1 but used as the event day for § 187 BGB. Posting 18.11 + 4 days = 22.11.2026 (Sunday). Amt Musterschlei is a general (non-tax) authority, so unlike Finanzamt the delivery day is NOT shifted for falling on a Sunday (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG / SH's § 110 LVwG analog; only the end of a period later moves, not the Bekanntgabe day itself). So Bekanntgabe = 22.11.2026. One-month Widerspruch period under §§ 187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB (via § 70 VwGO/analog SH procedure): day of event (22.11) not counted, period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number: 22.12.2026 (Tuesday). 22.12.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in SH, so no shift under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG-analog. Final deadline: 22.12.2026.
